d:
Shahdara Bar Association Honorary Secretary Narveer Dabas speaks exclusively to The Lallantop's Vikas Verma about the controversy surrounding suspended Delhi Police ACP Manasvi Vashishtha.
In this interview, Dabas addresses the ACP's controversial 'Kaale Coat Waale Gunde' remark, her viral AK-47 statement, the November 2 gathering at Delhi Police Headquarters, and the circumstances surrounding her suspension. He also presents the lawyers' version of the October 23 Shahdara police-lawyer confrontation, allegations of police intimidation, and the alleged pistol incident.
